title: Matt Crosby: Bitcoin Is “Primed for a Big Move Higher”
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Matt Crosby: Bitcoin Is “Primed for a Big Move Higher” Bitcoin's boring price action is a spring compressing for a breakout, says Matt Crosby. ETF flows, macro, and on-chain data point to a big move higher. This post Matt Crosby: Bitcoin Is “Primed for a Big Move Higher” first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
